'''2011 German National Championship Johan Van De Velde DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Johan Van De Velde]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|V1-D-imperialentanglements.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' IE
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
